\catcode`\{=1 \catcode`\}=2 \catcode`\#=6
\font\tenrm=cmr10 \tenrm
\hsize=200pt \vsize=100pt \parindent=15pt \baselineskip=12pt \topskip=10pt
\tolerance=1000 \maxdepth=2pt \parfillskip=0pt plus 1fil
\immediate\openout1=readback.aux
\immediate\write1{\noexpand\def\noexpand\a{written at once}}
\def\x{one}
\count0=1
Page one.\write1{\noexpand\def\noexpand\b{deferred \x\space on page \the\count0}}
\def\x{two}\def\space{ }
\vfill\penalty-10000
\count0=2
Page two.\write1{\noexpand\def\noexpand\c{on page \the\count0}}
\vfill\penalty-10000
\immediate\closeout1
\input readback.aux
\message{[\a][\b][\c]}
\openin3=readback.aux \read3 to\l \message{[\meaning\l]}\closein3
\openin4=readback.two \ifeof4 \message{[two: not yet]}\fi \closein4
\immediate\openout2=readback.two
\immediate\write2{first}
\immediate\closeout2
\openin4=readback.two \read4 to\l \message{[two closed: \meaning\l]}\closein4
\count0=3
A third page: \a, \b, \c.
\end
